newsitem.title: USA: Guidant defibrilator enters European market.
newsitem.headline: Guidant defibrilator enters European market.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Friday its VENTAK AV AICD Automatic Implantable Cardioverter Defibulator system was released for sale in the European market.
The new system incorporates Guidant's dual-chamber pacemaker therapy and defibrillation capabilities.
It said the device is designed to be implanted in the patient's shoulder area, which can significantly reduce the time and costs associated with the implant procedure and enhance patient comfort.
